title: The NASA Logotype
slide_intent: Introduce the shape that should identify the agency. Isolating the letters allows readers to inspect the continuity, strokes and unusual A forms that distinguish the mark.
strategic_value: NASA can concentrate recognition in one signature. A stable master can carry the same letterforms across different agency communications.
demonstration: Two text columns explain the design and reproduction guidance. A single large, solid black NASA logotype occupies the field below a horizontal rule.
practical_value: Use the isolated specimen to recognize the master form and consult section 2 for reproduction artwork.

content_islands.name: Description and reproduction guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading at upper left and the two explanatory columns to its right.

content_islands.name: Logotype specimen
content_islands.spec: Center one large horizontal black mark in the open lower field with generous white space around it.
